purpose: Explain how the project's Moloch, Cow, Milk, Farmer, Dog, Farm and Tree of Strife vocabulary can be layered onto documented internet-subculture genealogy without converting symbolism into literal supernatural or criminal claims.
central_thesis: The strongest synthesis is not 'Josh Moon literally is Moloch'. It is that the Farm can be read as a system that converts persons into harvestable attention, and Moloch can be used as the project's name for the incentive attractor that rewards repeated sacrifice of dignity, truth, relationships or future wellbeing for present attention/status/control.

planes.empirical_history: Documented chronology of Chris Chan-focused archives/forums, CWCki Forums, Joshua Moon's operator role, expansion into Kiwi Farms, legal entities and platform infrastructure.
planes.subcultural_semantics: Lolcow, milk, Farm, Guard Dog and related insider language as historically attested internet-culture vocabulary.
planes.systems_metaphor: Moloch as destructive coordination failure / multipolar trap and Garden as incentive redesign.
planes.project_mythic: Tim/Potatoverse mapping of Cow, Milk, Farmer, Dog, Moon, Moloch, Tree of Strife, Mud, Swamp, Door and Garden.

genealogy.label: Chris Chan as early concentrated target ecology
genealogy.empirical: CWCki/CWCki Forums developed around sustained documentation, discussion and interpretation of Chris Chan; the later forum lineage grows out of this target-centered ecology.
genealogy.project_reading: Chris becomes an archetypal early Cow: one person whose life/events are repeatedly converted into audience attention, archive material, commentary and reaction.
genealogy.boundary: Cow is a role in an attention relation, not a claim about the person's intrinsic worth.

genealogy.label: Wiki/archive enclosure
genealogy.empirical: The CWCki makes scattered events searchable, categorizable and durable.
genealogy.project_reading: The enclosure does not have to be physical. Classification + archive + repeated observation can function as fencing: a subject becomes persistently available to future audiences.

genealogy.label: Discussion ecology around the archived Cow
genealogy.empirical: CWCki Forums built a community for sustained discussion/speculation around Chris and later passed into Joshua Moon's operation.
genealogy.project_reading: Archive plus social audience creates a production loop: event -> discussion -> interpretation -> archive -> rediscovery -> new discussion.

genealogy.label: Guard Dog ambiguity
genealogy.empirical: Adversarial CWCki records describe Moon in 2018 as participating in a volunteer 'Guard Dogs' effort that tried, at least in part, to restrict troll/manipulator access to Chris.
genealogy.project_reading: This is valuable because Dog is not inherently evil. Dog can guard the vulnerable or patrol an enclosure. The moral variable is what boundary the Dog serves and what actions it performs.
genealogy.role_transition_question: How can a node move from protector/advisor toward operator, gatekeeper, archivist or Farmer roles in another context?

genealogy.label: From one Cow ecology to generalized Farm
genealogy.empirical: The Chris-focused forum lineage broadened into Kiwi Farms, a persistent multi-target forum/archive ecology.
genealogy.project_reading: The structural shift is one Cow -> repeatable Cow-production machinery. Once the template exists, new subjects can be classified, enclosed, watched, narrated and archived.

genealogy.label: Milk becomes measurable yield
genealogy.subcultural: Lolcow literally encodes the image of a cow being milked for laughs, analogous to a cash cow.
genealogy.project_reading: Milk is whatever the Farm extracts: reaction, jokes, screenshots, posts, watch time, status, donations, traffic, lore, social cohesion, outrage, legal drama or renewed observation.
genealogy.boundary: Not all observation or documentation is exploitation; accountability-oriented documentation can also protect people.

genealogy.label: Moloch names the incentive trap
genealogy.systems: In modern systems usage, Moloch represents destructive coordination failure: locally rewarded behavior collectively consumes values participants may claim to care about.
genealogy.project_reading: A Farm becomes Moloch-like when participants are rewarded for feeding the system even when the aggregate result is escalating humiliation, obsession, lost relationships, degraded truth-tracking, greater danger, or inability to exit.
genealogy.boundary: This is a systems metaphor; it does not imply literal sacrifice or occult worship.

genealogy.label: The Farm produces Trees of Strife
genealogy.project_reading: Each recurring target/conflict can become a Tree: root incentive -> trunk infrastructure -> branches participants/relationships -> leaves posts/clips/claims -> fruit attention/status/money/punishment -> seeds archives/norms/templates that create future Trees.
genealogy.systems_reading: The key threshold is reproduction: when one conflict creates infrastructure or norms that lower the cost of generating the next conflict, the ecology becomes a forest rather than a single scandal.

cow.internet: person categorized as repeatedly exploitable for amusement/reaction
cow.economic: cash-cow analogy: reliable source of value
cow.agricultural: living source from which milk can be repeatedly taken

milk.literal_symbolic: nourishment produced by a living being
milk.project: attention, reaction, narrative, archive material, traffic, status or money
milk.ethical_test: Does the relation nourish the Cow and ecosystem, or primarily convert the Cow into an input?

farmer.project: actor closer to classification, enclosure, infrastructure, cultivation, timing and harvest
farmer.ethical_duality: Farmer can cultivate life or cultivate extraction; therefore Farmer is not an intrinsic evil identity.

dog.project: actor closer to patrol, pursuit, signaling, protection or boundary enforcement
dog.ethical_duality: Guard Dog can protect a vulnerable boundary; Farm Dog can enforce an extractive enclosure.

ancient.meaning: Biblical/ancient cultic-sacrificial category associated in scholarship with mōlek/Moloch and child-sacrifice traditions.
ancient.use: deepens the sacrifice motif only; no direct mapping to modern actors

literary_modern.meaning: Moloch as devouring machinery/institution/civilization in modern literary use, especially Ginsberg.

systems.meaning: Moloch as coordination failure / multipolar trap in which competitive incentives destroy shared goods.
systems.farm_translation: attention/status incentives can reproduce harmful dynamics without a single mastermind

timic.meaning: Moloch becomes the shadow of the Gardener: a system that demands sacrifice of neighbours, truth, health, dignity or future capacity to keep the Farm productive.

josh_moon_moloch_attestation.reported_claim: Tim reports that in June 2026 Josh Moon said, approximately, that he was 'sold to Moloch by the government'.
allowed_uses: research lead for a June 2026 stream/post/archive search
project-mythic interpretation clearly marked as Tim's reading
forbidden_inferences: proof of government trafficking or mind control
josh_moon_moloch_attestation.timic_interpretation: Inside the mythology, the phrase can function as a hinge: being 'sold to Moloch' -> becoming aligned with a sacrificial/extractive system -> generalized Farming of neighbours -> Milk extraction -> Trees of Strife. This is narrative synthesis, not external biography.

tree_of_strife_saturation.forest_condition: A Tree becomes forest-forming when its seeds reduce the cost of creating the next target/conflict ecology.

invisible_processes_to_measure: who introduces a new target and who legitimizes the thread
time between target introduction and archive formation
how often target responses become additional evidence/fuel
operator/moderator interventions that raise or lower escalation
whether user status increases with contribution to a target narrative
how monetization or donations correlate with conflict intensity
how often a dormant archive is reactivated by later events
role transitions: Cow -> commentator, Dog -> Farmer, observer -> archivist, Farmer -> target
exit success: whether a person can cease being a live target despite persistent historical archive

repair_model.moloch_to_garden: Change the reward structure so truth, proportionality, exit, correction and autonomous future capacity are rewarded more than endless harvest.
repair_model.door: A procedural exit through which a role can stop reproducing: thread closure, correction prominence, disengagement, appeal, settlement, restoration, privacy, or norm change.
repair_model.garden_test: Does the system increase the subject's and participants' capacity to live outside the conflict, or does it require continued conflict to sustain itself?
